US Congress.title: Congress.gov Notifications September Events - Save the Date
US Congress.summary:
If you are interested in learning more about legislative data, what's new on Congress.gov, celebrating the U.S. Constitution, or discovering the breadth and depth of the Federal Depository Library Program, please join us at these September events!

 

September 10 - Congressional Data Task Force (virtual event; register here)

 

September 18 - Law Library of Congress Constitution Day (hybrid event; in-person registration, online registration)
